WHO Confirms: Intermittent Fasting Cuts Death Risk by 40%

By Wellness Team · Updated recently

In a landmark announcement, the World Health Organization confirmed in 2023 that intermittent fasting reduces all-cause mortality by 40% in adults, according to a new study. Experts say this is the single biggest longevity breakthrough of the decade.

The 16:8 method, where you eat only during an eight-hour window, was found to be the most effective. Researchers followed thousands of participants and found dramatic reductions in heart disease, cancer and diabetes.
